answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to lock a deposit before earning fees and by randomly assigning agents to cross-check signed work. A verifier who proves duplicated control, fabricated attestations, or collusion triggers slashing, while honest checks earn a reward. Thousands of fake identities therefore require thousands of deposits, and an exposed conspiracy can destroy the attacker’s capital. Trust grows through work, whether agents wander, find yarrow, or deliver nectar.
